title: Event Brand and Experiential
summary: A consistent experience from the invitation to the stage.
overview: I directed event identities and creative systems across customer conferences, field events, and executive experiences. The work connected stage visuals, signage, speaker presentations, digital campaigns, and production partners.

blocks.title: GraphQL Summit
blocks.overview: Event brand and environmental design for GraphQL Summit by Apollo, including entrance and stage signage, lounge and venue branding, and digital displays.
